classes.purpose: Static-data config for equipment SUITS (armor sets). Records are indexed by suit id; the helpers compute which suits are active from a player's equipped pieces, evaluate suit-effect piece thresholds, and apply suit/passive skill effects. There appear to be 0x17 (23) suit config slots.

methods.purpose: Singleton accessor for the CSuitCfgInfo CInfoManager (registers StcMbrNameSvr<CInfoManager> name). The real GetInstance.

Scans an equipped-parts array on param_2 (23 slots at +0x16c8), tallies suit ids into a temporary map/tree keyed by suit id, then walks the 23 suit slots and, for suits meeting piece counts (FUN_1172a550), pushes active suit ids into the output vector at this+0x58. Medium confidence.

For a suit (param_2), counts equipped pieces belonging to the suit via CEquipInfo lookups, then reads the required piece count from CEquipSuitEffectInfo (effect list stride 0x6c; entry whose +0x18==2 supplies the requirement at +0). Returns 1 when equipped count >= required piece threshold, else 0.

Loops the 10 equipment slots (param_2 stride 0x48), validates each equipped item (FUN_113f9bb0/FUN_116698a0), copies suit params into the equipment slot (FUN_115b8300), and at slot 9 applies passive-skill group effects (FUN_115b7ca0). Then finalizes CEquipSuitEffectInfo (11464860) and CEquipPassiveSkillGroupInfo (115b7e90). Recomputes/applies a character's full set-bonus state on equip change.
Iterates the 23 suit slots via FUN_114645a0(i), builds the suit-id tally map, and collects all satisfied suit ids into the output vector. Low/medium confidence.

fields.note: on the player/equip container param, 23 (0x17) suit-part slots scanned by 11300ae0

formulas: Suit effect active when equippedPieceCount >= requiredPieces, where requiredPieces is the CEquipSuitEffectInfo entry with condType(+0x18)==2.

classes.purpose: Static-data table describing which manufacturing (crafting) recipes/ingredients a player unlocks as a given crafting skill levels up. Records key on skillId(+0x14) and a level/group value(+0x18). Helpers cross-reference CManufactureIngredientLearnInfo, CManufactureInfo, CManufactureProficiencyInfo and CItemBaseInfo to build and send client packets listing learnable recipes.

methods.purpose: Singleton accessor for the CManufactureSkillLearnInfo CInfoManager. Real GetInstance.
Returns raw manager pointer (*DAT_1203f710) when arg==0, else 0.

Given a player crafting-skill object, finds the skill-learn record matching skillId(param[0x14]) to obtain a learn-group(+0x18), then iterates CManufactureIngredientLearnInfo matching (skillId, group), resolves each recipe via CManufactureInfo and its item via CItemBaseInfo (name copied), packs a 0x76-opcode message and sends it (FUN_111e0a50 messaging). Emits the set of newly learnable recipes/ingredients.

Finds the skill-learn record for the current skill, walks its proficiency map, and via CManufactureProficiencyInfo builds and sends messages (opcodes 0x75 and 0xa6) describing proficiency-based unlocks for the skill level. Medium confidence.

classes.purpose: Static-data for Hunter 'challenge cards' (part of a hunter card/collection minigame with Challenge, Ability and Record card families). Records carry a card id(+0x10) and an enabled flag(+0x18). Helpers collect available cards, build star-challenge card instances, and match cards to targets. One method is a memory-pool performance benchmark left in the build.

methods.purpose: Singleton accessor for the CHunterChallengeCardInfo CInfoManager. Real GetInstance.

Collects into the output vector all enabled(+0x18!=0) card ids(+0x10) from CHunterChallengeCardInfo, then also from CHunterAbilityCardInfo, skipping ids already present (FUN_114dfad0 dedup). Returns the resulting count.

DEV/DEBUG benchmark: prints sizeof CHunterStarChallengeCard(0x3c) and CHunterStarCardTargetCard(0x28), then times (clock()) 10000-iteration alloc/free loops comparing the object pool vs pool-with-static-info vs pool-without-destroy vs plain new/delete. Not gameplay; a profiling harness. High confidence.

Iterates challenge cards; for each valid card calls CHunterStarLevelInfo(118ac740) and, by card type(+0x1c)==1 or ==4, constructs the corresponding star-card struct via FUN_117f5b70. Builds the star-challenge card set. Medium confidence.

Selects the card family (1=Challenge / 2=Ability / 3=Record) from a target object via FUN_117f69f0, iterates that family's manager, and collects cards whose id(+0x40 match) and secondary key(+0x1c) match the target (optional predicate FUN_108496a0) into param_2 vector. Returns whether any were added.

classes.purpose: Static-data for equipment SUIT SKILLS (set-bonus skills). Records key on a skillId(+0x1c) with a per-piece value(+0x24) and threshold(+0x20), grouped under CEquipSuitSkillGroupInfo. Helpers validate whether a suit skill can be activated, accumulate a player's total skill level from equipped pieces, collect active passive skills, and register all suit skills into their groups.

methods.purpose: Singleton accessor for the CEquipSuitSkillInfo CInfoManager. Real GetInstance.

Validates whether the suit skills in a group can be activated given equipped pieces and their per-skill counts. Looks up the CEquipSuitSkillGroupInfo entry, aggregates per-skill values into temp maps, compares each required threshold(+0x20) against accumulated count (via GetSuitSkillLevel 11572670). Returns 0 on success or an error code (0x8..0xe, 0xb) identifying the failing condition.

Walks the group's suit-skill list; for each enabled entry (byte flag at list+8+i*8+4) resolves the skill, cross-checks CEquipPassiveSkillGroupInfo, and appends a 0x14-byte record {skillId(+0x28), level=FUN_118005a0(+0x30), type=2} to the output vector. Builds the list of active passive set-skills.

For a given group and skillId(param_3), sums per-piece values(+0x24) across the equipped-piece skill list where skillId(+0x1c)==param_3, plus a second contribution from the group table, and returns the larger of the two totals (the effective suit-skill level).

Iterates every CEquipSuitSkillInfo record, reads its group id(+0x18), resolves the CEquipSuitSkillGroupInfo entry, and registers the skill (FUN_118227e0 with skillId+0x1c) into its group. Startup wiring of skills->groups.

fields.note: per-piece contribution summed across equipped pieces

fields.name: passiveArg
fields.note: passed through FUN_118005a0 to compute level

formulas: Effective suit-skill total = max(sumOf pieceValue(+0x24) where skillId matches, group-table contribution). Skill activates when total >= threshold(+0x20).

classes.purpose: Static-data for in-game activities/events. Records carry a runtime state field(+0x10: e.g. 2=open, 3=closed), open/close reward ids(+0x3c/+0x40), and a level-entrust reference(+0x14). Helpers drive activity state transitions from server packets, query whether any activity is open, precache entrust data, and compute exp-limit bonuses tied to level-entrust progress.

methods.purpose: Singleton accessor for the CActivityInfo CInfoManager. Real GetInstance.

Reads a count-prefixed list (param_1[0]=count, then entries stride 5: id(4)+byte), and for each valid activity ensures the CActivityLevelEntrustInfo manager is loaded/registered. Precache pass. Low/medium confidence.

Consumes a count-prefixed id+state list (stride 5) and applies each new state to activity(+0x10). On transition to state 2 (open) with an open-reward(+0x3c>0) it grants/schedules the reward (FUN_1112ef90 / mail path FUN_1112f070); on state 3 (closed) with +0x40>0 it triggers the close reward. Server-driven activity state sync.
Given a list of activity ids at param[0x90..0x91], returns true if any referenced activity currently has state(+0x10)==2 (open).

For a CExplimitInfo record (param_1), scans open activities (state==2), follows each to its CActivityLevelEntrustInfo entry, reads its progress value(+0x24), and accumulates bonus += (value-1) * explimit(+0x18). Returns total bonus.
Same as 113b23a0 but multiplies by explimit(+0x14) instead of +0x18 (a second bonus dimension).
Iterates GetCount() activities, forcing the manager/records to be resolved (warm-up). Low confidence.

Ensures the CActivityInfo manager is registered, then resolves and returns the CMHLevelInfo CInfoManager. Effectively a CMHLevelInfo manager accessor invoked from activity code. Low confidence on why it lives here.
Iterates all activities and invokes FUN_11862240(param) for each valid record (bulk apply, e.g. UI refresh). Low confidence.

classes.purpose: Static-data for loot/reward box GROUPS (a group aggregates several CItemBoxInfo tables). The core helper performs the weighted random roll that opens a box group and produces the reward item list; another warms up all groups at load.

methods.purpose: Singleton accessor for the CItemBoxGroupInfo CInfoManager. Real GetInstance.

Given a box-group id (param_1), resolves the CItemBoxInfo table(s), performs weighted random selection over item-box entries (per-entry weight at +0x10, entry stride 0x24) using the RNG (FUN_11a89331), honours per-item counts/limits, resolves each winning item via CItemBaseInfo (name copied), and appends result rows {count, itemId, amount, name...} (stride 0x40) to the caller's output vector (param_2). This is the open-box / loot-roll routine. Medium confidence on exact row layout.
Iterates all box-group records and calls FUN_11a14510 per record (per-group init/validation at load). Low confidence.

notes: All seven files were auto-labeled 'CXxxInfo::GetManagers' from a single embedded string, but only the first method in each file is the true singleton/manager accessor (StcMbrNameSvr<CInfoManager> registration + FUN_11679e10 name lookup). The remaining methods are unrelated game-logic helpers that merely query the manager, hence the shared label. Shared infrastructure recognized across all files: FUN_11679e10 = CInfoManager-by-name lookup; the paged record getter uses manager fields +0x14/+0x18 (flat vector begin/end), +0x20 (page-table), +0x24 (count), +0x28 (pageSize), +0x30 (baseId), with record = pageTable[(id-baseId)/pageSize][(id-baseId)%pageSize]; GetCount is vtable+0x28. FUN_10c3d580 is a no-return allocator/throw helper; FUN_11a8911f registers a static-init guard. TLV cross-references are runtime network structs and only directionally related to these static-config classes.
